data.one_liner: Low level interface for native APIs such as clipboard and Drag and Drop
data.what_it_does: Provides low-level native functionality for clipboard and drag-and-drop operations. It serves as an underlying engine plugin and is not meant to be used directly by application code.
use_when: You are using plugins like super_clipboard or super_drag_and_drop that depend on it
avoid_when: You want to use clipboard or drag and drop features directly in your app
You are building an application without dependencies on packages that require it
strengths: Enables advanced clipboard and drag-and-drop capabilities across multiple platforms
weaknesses: Not meant to be used directly by developers
data.setup_notes: Automatically included as a transitive dependency by packages that require it.
